title: Ordinary arcs on unpunctured triangulated orbifolds with orders>=3 have principal-coefficient Laurent expansions given by the weighted perfect matchings of their generalized snake graphs
author: Esther Banaian; Elizabeth Kelley
difficulty_reason: The obligation is to extend a surface matching expansion to pending orbifold arcs while preserving both exchange polynomials and principal coefficients. The proof builds an explicit polygon lift, modifies the crossing-reduction induction, verifies the coefficient specialization and tracks the doubled shear-coordinate contributions of pending laminations. These interacting geometric and combinatorial constructions are substantially beyond ordinary qualifying cluster definitions or a routine perfect-matching count.

proof_review.note: The complete new ordinary-arc proof of Theorem4.4 was read through Sections5–10, with the generalized tile definitions, matching statistics and elementary-lamination/shear conventions. It explicitly constructs the polygon lift when consecutive pending arcs occur, proves the quadrilateral/bigon crossing induction, defines and checks the specialization on first mutations, matches principal-coefficient exponents and transfers the ordinary polygon matching expansion. The standard surface polygon theorem and BFZ acyclic presentation are genuine prior background; the new orbifold steps are supplied. The critical construction/pentagon/lamination diagrams on physical pp.11,12,18,24,26 were rendered and inspected. Select ordinary non-self-intersecting arcs and orbifold orders >=3; generalized winding curves, closed band graphs and separate matrix formulas are not counted.

statement_scope: Exactly the ordinary, non-self-intersecting arc branch of Theorem4.4, on an unpunctured bordered orbifold O=(S,M,Q) of Definition3.3, with each boundary component marked, a triangulation T and principal coefficients relative to its generalized seed. Restrict every orbifold order to p>=3, hence lambda_p=2*cos(pi/p)>0. Standard arcs use 1+u and pending arcs 1+lambda_p*u+u^2 as exchange polynomials. For an ordinary standard or pending arc gamma, x_gamma equals (sum_P x(P)y(P))/cross(T,gamma) with the exact tiles, edge weights, minimal matching and height statistics of Sections2–4. No self-intersecting generalized arc, closed curve, band graph, or order-2 specialization is included.
editorial_warning: Editorial scope notice, separate from the author: the printed Theorem4.4 permits order2, but this packet intentionally selects orders p>=3. In Section7 the coefficient semifield includes invertible polygon boundary variables, and some are mapped to lambda_p*x_rho; the selected positive lambda_p scope keeps that explicitly printed coefficient map within nonzero values. No order2 specialization argument or corrected proof is added. The reference to “Fig.9” in Lemma9.2 is retained; the relevant pending-lamination diagram is displayed on the same physical p.26 as Figure4.
